sentences.text:
Heard Mr. U.Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Mr. B.Sarma,
learned Addl. P.P., Assam for the State respondent No.1.
Also heard Ms. R.Choudhury, learned Amicus Curiae for the respondent No. 2.

By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Kaifuddin Ahmed has prayed for grant of bail in connection with POCSO Case No. 90/2024 pending in the court of learned Special Judge, Morigaion under Section 366/376 (1) IPC r/w Section 4 of POCSO Act (Bhuragaon P.S. Case No. 36/2024).
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been in judicial custody for last 148 days since his arrest on 17.04.2024.

Charge sheet has been laid in connection with the case and thereafter two witnesses i.e. the informant and the victim were examined and as such,
considering length of detention, petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

The learned Addl.P.P. and learned counsel for the respondent No.2 submit that though the victim has implicated the petitioner for his involvement in the case, however, in view of the fact that informant and the victim have been examined by the learned trial court, the bail prayer of the petitioner may be considered.
Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the scanned copy of case records and also the fact that the prime witnesses have already been examined, considering length of detention, this Court is of the considered Page No.# 3/3 opinion that further custodial detention of the petitioner is not warranted.
Accordingly, it is provided that the petitioner named above shall be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 50,000/- with two sureties of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge,
(POCSO) Act, Morigaon,

subject to the following conditions;-
(i) The petitioner shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of learned Special Judge (POCSO Act),
Morigaon without prior written permission from him/her;
ii) That the petitioner shall continue to appear before the learned trial Court on all dates to be fixed from time to time till the case is disposed of; and iii) That the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any of the remaining prosecution witnesses.
Violation of any condition shall tentamount to cancellation of bail.
